name: Ecological Pyramid of Trophic Levels & 10% Energy Flow
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Ch 15 (Fig 15.2) laboratory-grade 4-tier 3D ecological stepped pyramid representing Producers (10,000 J), Herbivores (1,000 J), Carnivores (100 J), and Top Predators (10 J) demonstrating Lindeman's 10% energy transfer law. Features dual presentation collections: Pyramid_Full (complete architectural pyramid with ascending illuminated energy vectors and step boundary trims) and Pyramid_Section (90-degree cutaway revealing central retained 10% core and radiating 90% heat dissipation vectors with thermal emission plumes).
simplifications: Stepped tier format with labeled energy values (10,000 J, 1,000 J, 100 J, 10 J).
Color gradation illustrates energy attenuation from rich green producers to crimson apex predators.
Section view models Lindeman's 10% trophic transfer law showing 90% lost as metabolic heat to surroundings.

materials.look: Lush vibrant emerald green base tier (Producers / 10,000 J)
Warm amber/gold intermediate tier (Primary Consumers / 1,000 J)
Vibrant orange secondary consumer tier (Small Carnivores / 100 J)
Deep crimson red apex tier (Top Predators / 10 J)
Clean luminescent white boundary step edges
